categories.main_business_segments: Amlogic (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. is a fabless semiconductor company specializing in the design, development, and sales of system-on-chip (SoC) products. Its primary business segments include multimedia smart terminal SoC chips, wireless connectivity chips, and automotive electronics chips. These products serve various consumer electronics fields such as smart set-top boxes, smart TVs, smart cars, smart projectors, smart speakers, and other intelligent devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced SoC design integrating CPU, GPU, neural network processors, video/audio codecs, display controllers, memory systems, and network interfaces. It has developed 11 core proprietary technologies including full-format video and audio decoding, global digital TV demodulation, ultra-high-definition image processing, high-speed peripheral interfaces, chip-level security solutions, ultra-low power consumption technologies, memory bandwidth compression, and large-scale mixed-signal IC design. Manufacturing is outsourced to specialized foundries and packaging/testing firms, consistent with the fabless model.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global telecom operators, OEMs, and ODMs in consumer electronics, automotive, office, education, fitness, industrial, commercial, agricultural, and entertainment sectors. Major clients include domestic and international operators such as China Mobile, China Unicom, China Telecom, and global streaming platforms like Netflix, Google, and Amazon. The company also collaborates with leading smart terminal manufacturers including Xiaomi, TCL, Haier, Hisense, and others.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with significant presence in Mainland China, Hong Kong, North America, Europe, Latin America, Asia-Pacific, and Africa. It has subsidiaries and R&D centers in Shanghai, Shenzhen, Beijing, Xi'an, Chengdu, Nanjing, Hong Kong, California (USA), Singapore, Korea, and Nevada (USA).
categories.supply_chain_position: Amlogic operates upstream in the semiconductor supply chain as a fabless IC design company. It focuses on chip design and development while outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to third-party foundries and service providers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous high-intensity R&D investment, focusing on advanced process nodes (e.g., 6nm chips), intelligent edge computing capabilities, ultra-high-definition video processing (up to 8K), Wi-Fi 6 wireless connectivity, and automotive-grade chips. It pursues innovation in AI-enabled smart terminals, multi-format codec support, and integration of neural network processors. Future R&D priorities include expanding smart home, automotive electronics, and wireless connectivity product lines, enhancing operational efficiency, and deepening global market penetration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of SoC chips and related semiconductor products. The company sells to OEMs, ODMs, and operators via direct sales and distribution channels. It also earns income from licensing intellectual property and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Amlogic is a leading domestic and globally recognized SoC design company, especially dominant in smart set-top box and smart TV chip markets. It competes with other domestic IC design firms and international semiconductor companies with stronger capital and technology bases. The company maintains a competitive edge through proprietary core technologies, extensive customer relationships, and broad product portfolio.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Amlogic achieved record revenues of RMB 5.93 billion, a 10.34% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 822 million, up 65.03%. The company has sustained rapid growth with continuous R&D spending exceeding RMB 1.35 billion annually. Total assets reached RMB 7.37 billion with net assets of RMB 6.39 billion, reflecting a solid financial foundation and improving operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Amlogic differentiates itself by delivering high-performance, low-power, highly integrated SoC solutions with advanced multimedia processing and AI capabilities. Its chips support a wide range of video/audio formats, global digital TV standards, and smart edge computing features enhancing user experience in multi-language environments. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, stable customer base, and comprehensive product ecosystem provide customers with reliable, cost-effective, and innovative semiconductor solutions tailored for diverse intelligent terminal applications.
